dashboard.headline: Channel overview
dashboard.sub: English-first content strategy. Connect YouTube to manage channels (read, upload, and metadata where granted).
dashboard.apiDown: Backend unreachable. Start the API on port 8000.
dashboard.trendsBody: Hot posts from a public subreddit via Reddit’s OAuth client-credentials flow. Cached briefly to reduce API calls.
dashboard.trendsNotConfigured: Reddit is not configured. Set REDDIT_CLIENT_ID, REDDIT_CLIENT_SECRET, and REDDIT_USER_AGENT in .env.
dashboard.editBody: Planned: Whisper transcripts, FFmpeg cuts, export to an editor-friendly format.
dashboard.oauthNote: OAuth opens Google in this window. Tokens stay in your local SQLite database. You return to the same language you started from.
dashboard.oauthNoRefresh: No refresh token. In Google Account settings, remove this app’s access and connect again.
